overview: This 176-page file traces U.S. occupation policy toward Japanese trade unions from December 1946 to April 1948. It includes Far Eastern Commission principles, correspondence about a World Federation of Trade Unions visit, reports on labor in Japan and Korea, and SCAP material on women workers, union democracy, farmers’ organizations, and teachers’ unions.
interest: Policy directives, diplomatic disputes, and detailed union studies show how occupation authorities and workers contested postwar labor organization.
